description: What an app on this machine was used for since it last said (about a minute): kept by its host, on that machine only (its state folder's telemetry/, a file a day), for Settings → Telemetry. Sent by an app to its own machine's host only (the phone's to its own host), never on to another.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

app.description: The app it's of: Baude, Record, or the phone's app.

seconds.description: Seconds each place was on screen in a window in front, with input in the last minute: by place, the schema/copy key that names it (a main view, a side panel page, a view over the window, a dialog; one of each may be on screen at once).

uses.description: Times each menu item or action was used: by the schema/copy key of the menu item's words where it has one (window.settings, …), else its action's name (win.export).
